The new language is used the next time AENHT opens.
Automatic moves the tab bar to the side of the screen you touched last.
Recent searches show when you start a search and sync through iCloud with your settings. When this is off, new searches aren\'t saved and the list is hidden.
Scrolling down a list hides the bars at the top and bottom, and scrolling up shows them again. With Hide Search Too off, a round search button stays.
The tab bar moves to the side of the screen you touch: Fast at the first touch, Medium after two touches on that side, Slow after four.
Scrolling down a list slides the tab bar away; scrolling up brings it back.
The reader\'s controls hide on their own after this long without a touch.
Scrolling down a list shrinks the tab bar to a small button; scrolling up brings it back.
Choose how many columns of cards to show. Phones start with 2 in portrait and 4 in landscape, tablets with 3 and 5. A narrow window (Split View) may show fewer.
The column counts sync with your other devices over iCloud. iPhone and iPad each keep their own.

Copy these cookies of e-hentai.org from a browser where you are logged in. igneous is only needed for ExHentai, and is usually picked up by itself.
ExHentai shows galleries that E-Hentai hides. It needs an account that has been given access.
A site that is turned off disappears everywhere in the app. At least one stays on.
“Same as Home” shows the site the home page is on.
Searches both sites at once. E-Hentai pauses networks that send too many requests, so this is off by default.
Needs an account with ExHentai access

Galleries that match a rule are left out of Home and search results on both sites. A tag rule matches the tag in any namespace (nhentai\'s tag: and E-Hentai\'s female:, male:, …).
Uses the tag blacklist of your nhentai account (nhentai.net › Settings › Blacklist).
Used when no language model is set up or all of them fail. A key from Azure Translator has a free monthly allowance.
Brightness, grayscale and inverted colors apply only to the pages.
Brightness, grayscale and inverted colors apply only to the pages. Grayscale and inverted colors need Android 12 or later.

The device can\'t translate from this language.

The last fallback, free: Google\'s on-device translation (ML Kit). The first time, it downloads a language model of about 30 MB for each language.
The last fallback, free: Apple\'s on-device translation. The first time, the system offers to download each language.
Connected. The app keeps its file in the AENHT folder.
For example Nextcloud, a NAS, or Jianguoyun (use an app password). The password stays on this device and isn\'t exported with the settings.
Syncs the settings, the reading history and the favorites copy with your other devices, Android or iPhone. Automatically: when the app opens and when it goes to the background.
The server refused the user name or password.
Rows of covers above the feed, at most two. They load with the feed and on refresh.
Tried from top to bottom: a model that refuses, fails or reaches its monthly spending limit hands over to the next one, then to Microsoft Translator, then to the on-device translation.
Torrent links are made for your account; don\'t share them.
Comments by this user are hidden on every gallery. Unblock in Settings › Filters.
Their comments are hidden on E-Hentai galleries. Long-press a comment to block its author.
Viewing and downloading pages counts toward this limit; it recovers over time.
Saving pages needs Android 10 or later. Share the page instead.
More at once is faster but more likely to be limited by the site. E-Hentai uses at most 3 pages at once.
A pause before each page, gentler on the sites.
Original images are larger; on E-Hentai they cost GP from your account when the file is big.
The archive is a zip of the whole gallery from E-Hentai\'s servers. Its cost is taken from your account\'s GP.
Separate tags with commas, with a namespace: female:glasses, artist:name. Adding votes for them.

Tap an account to switch to it.
Asks for your fingerprint, face or device PIN when the app opens or comes back, and hides it in recent apps.
Set a screen lock on this device first.
Asks for Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode when the app opens or comes back, and hides it in the app switcher.
The diagnostic log lists what went wrong in this session (failed requests, translations, sync), without tokens, cookies or keys.
What the app shows when you switch away from it, so the app switcher shows nothing private. Blurring needs Android 12; before that the app is covered.
What the app shows when you switch away from it, so the app switcher shows nothing private.
The reader keeps the screen on this long after the last touch, then leaves it to the system\'s own auto-lock (it never turns the screen off sooner than the system would).

Sharpens low-resolution pages to your screen\'s resolution, on this device. A page shows at once and turns sharper when it\'s ready. Automatic: only pages clearly smaller than the screen; on slower devices, only the page you\'re on.
A long swipe. Not when it goes the way the pages turn or scroll (that turns them), nor while a page is zoomed in.
Pasting a key fetches the provider’s model list. If listing is unavailable, choose Other Model and enter its ID.
Test sends only the selected sample to this endpoint with the current key and model. Provider fees may apply. Saving alone sends no translation request.
The key stays visible for checking pasted text. It is saved only in this device’s Keychain, separately for each service.
The key stays visible for checking pasted text. It is saved only on this device, encrypted, separately for each service.
Changing the endpoint clears a previously saved key. Paste a replacement for the new destination.
Price provided by the service and kept up to date automatically.
This provider does not publish prices. Enter the price from its pricing page; update it when it changes.

Tokens are counted from what the provider reports for each request, and costed at the price in effect at that moment. When this month’s spending reaches the limit, this service is skipped: the next one in the order takes over, then the on-device engine. A limit needs a price.

Model defaults sends no reasoning override. Choose only parameters supported by your model; stronger reasoning can increase latency. Gemini\'s compatible API also accepts reasoning_effort on supported models.
Custom values override the preset. For example: {\"temperature\":0.2,\"max_completion_tokens\":4096}. Do not put credentials here. Test Translation uses these same parameters.
Enter a JSON object of at most 16 KB.
Model, messages, stream, tools, credentials and response count are managed by the app.
Use only one of max_tokens and max_completion_tokens.

With fading page turns, pages don\'t slide: the next one fades in where you are, easier on the eyes when turning quickly.
With Fade on Swipe, the pages don\'t move with your finger: a swipe turns to the next or previous page, and the new one fades in, sweeping the way you swiped.

The two pinned rows side by side.
The details on the left, every page on the right. Three Columns keeps the thumbnails\' size and leaves more room to the details.
The details and the pages on the left; the other versions, similar galleries and comments on the right.
Gallery pages show as on a phone: one column.
The list on the left, the chosen page on the right.

Pinch with two fingers to make the pages smaller or bigger. With Keep Page Size, that size stays for every page and the next galleries; drag the black sides to move the pages. Reset Size, at the bottom of the reader, brings back the usual size.
Swipe Fade: the pages don\'t move; the page fades away with a soft edge that follows your finger. Stop and it stops; a quick swipe turns at once.
Slide: the pages slide with your finger.
Spread Fade: a tap turns the page with a fade spreading from where you tapped.
Page Fade: a tap fades the whole page into the next.
A tap slides the next page in.
How a tap turns the page (slide, page fade or spread fade) is set in Reading › Tap to Turn.
Pinching in can make a page smaller than the screen, with black around it. Off, a page fills the screen at least; pinching only enlarges it.
Double Tap Top to Go to Start
Double-tap the title at the top of the reader to go back to the first page.
Detected: Apple Pencil Pro (it was squeezed).
Detected: Apple Pencil (2nd generation) or Pro (it was double-tapped).
Double-tap is off in Settings › Apple Pencil, so the reader doesn\'t respond to it.
Squeeze is off in Settings › Apple Pencil, so the reader doesn\'t respond to it.
This iPad works with Apple Pencil Pro: while reading, double-tap or squeeze it, held away from the screen.
This iPad works with Apple Pencil (2nd generation): while reading, double-tap it, held away from the screen. Squeezing needs Apple Pencil Pro, which this iPad doesn\'t work with.
The Apple Pencil this iPad works with can\'t double-tap or squeeze, so it can\'t turn pages.
While reading, double-tap Apple Pencil (2nd generation) or Pro, or squeeze Apple Pencil Pro, held away from the screen.
Try it here: double-tap or squeeze the pencil.

→ ↓, Page Down and Space turn to the next page; ← ↑ and Page Up to the previous one (← → follow the reading direction). In the continuous modes they scroll a screen. Most Bluetooth page turners send these keys; ones that send the volume buttons can\'t turn pages on iPhone and iPad.

→ ↓, Page Down and Space turn to the next page; ← ↑ and Page Up to the previous one (← → follow the reading direction). In the continuous modes they scroll a screen. Most Bluetooth page turners send these keys; ones that send the volume buttons use Volume Keys Turn Pages.
While reading, press a button of the stylus held over the screen; pens with Bluetooth buttons (Android 14 and later) work away from it too. Which buttons a pen has depends on the pen.

Galaxy S Pen: turn on AENHT in Settings › Advanced features › S Pen › Air actions. Then a press of the S Pen\'s button turns to the next page, a double press to the previous one, and swipes left and right in the air turn too.
A Windows pen paired over Bluetooth (such as Surface Pen): a click of its top button turns to the next page, a double click to the previous one.
Filled in from the copied text.
The copied text has no E-Hentai cookies.
Copied cookies are filled in by themselves, all of them at once: a Cookie header, a cookie extension\'s export or a cookies.txt file. Pasting into any field works too.
Tap the Middle to Show Controls
Tap the Middle to Show Controls: a tap on either side (where the tap zones are; left and right when scrolling) doesn\'t show or hide the controls.

Opening Favorites reloads the site\'s list, so a gallery just favorited is there without pulling to refresh. Not when the list is scrolled down (your place stays). All syncs its copy when it\'s older than 15 minutes.
They are removed from your favorites on the site too.

The buttons float above the slider: one alone on the side of your hand (where you tapped to show the controls); both, Auto Read on the side chosen and Reader Settings on the other. Reader Settings is also in the menu at the top right.
Long-press the Auto Read button for its speed and options; a tap starts or stops it.
Save the settings as a file and import it on another device. The file also works with the iOS app.
Android\'s own backup also keeps these settings.

Recent searches show when you start a search. When this is off, new searches aren\'t saved and the list is hidden.
